title: Verified Hook Library (100 Hooks)
description: Harvest 40 proven hooks from Instagram, YouTube, and Threads, then expand to 100 via pattern templates — a reusable hook library CSV the whole team pulls from.

nodes.title: Harvest 15 high-performing IG Reels hooks
nodes.detail: On Instagram, browse niche hashtags and the explore surface to find 15 high-engagement Reels. Record each one's opening line (on-screen text or first caption line) verbatim, with the source URL and approximate engagement.
nodes.acceptance: 15 Reels hooks captured verbatim with sources.

nodes.title: Harvest 15 YouTube title and intro hooks
nodes.detail: Search the niche on YouTube for Shorts and high-view videos. Capture 15 hooks from titles and opening lines, with view counts and source URLs. Avoid duplicating hooks already collected from Instagram.
nodes.acceptance: 15 YouTube hooks captured with sources and view counts.

nodes.title: Harvest 10 Threads post hooks
nodes.detail: On Threads, browse niche conversations and capture the first lines of 10 high-engagement posts. Prioritize text-native hook styles (confession, hot take, plot twist).
nodes.acceptance: 10 Threads hooks captured verbatim with sources.

nodes.title: Verify harvested hooks
nodes.detail: Check that the three channels total 35+ hooks, no near-duplicate pairs exist, and every entry has a source URL.

nodes.title: Classify patterns and expand to 100
nodes.detail: Classify the ~40 harvested hooks by psychological trigger (curiosity gap, numbered promise, relatable callout, plot twist, warning, social proof, secret reveal, etc.) and turn each type's sentence structure into a reusable template. Apply the templates to the niche and client context to generate 60 derived hooks, reaching 100 total. Derived hooks inherit their source type's tag.

subtasks.title: Classify by trigger type
subtasks.purpose: Label all harvested hooks into 7–8 types

outputScope.name: hook_library
outputScope.description: 100 of hook, trigger_type, origin (harvested/derived), source_url, suggested_channel

nodes.title: Save the hook library CSV
nodes.detail: Write the 100 hooks to a CSV. Columns: number, hook line, trigger type, origin (harvested/derived), source URL, suggested channel, usage log (blank — updated later by the performance retro workflow). Sort by trigger type.
nodes.acceptance: CSV saved with all 100 rows filled.

subtasks.title: Map rows to the schema
subtasks.purpose: Library entries into the column layout
